record.body: Durable learning: an autonomic manufacturing run is itself a process subject whose RUNNING -> manufacture -> PR -> qualification -> merge -> durable-memory transitions must be independently observable. Generic scheduler failure strings are insufficient evidence. R68 adds public-semantic checkpoint law and 50 executable sensors that separate queue pressure, polling pressure, API failure, moving exact heads, missing receipts, qualification/merge identity, post-actuation gaps, semantic yield, and failure-to-opportunity conversion.
